sentence: The configurational evidence makes the combination itself the unit of analysis: for food firms, performance follows recipes that join marketing capabilities, customer co-creation, market orientation and an AI marketing strategy [CITE], and in retail the payoff grows out of combinations of AI applications rather than any single use
passage: [Cao et al. (2025), p. 1] "superior performance stems not from isolated AI uses but from synergistic combinations--particularly those involving customer service and cybersecurity--interacting with other functions. These configurations appear to give rise to emergent capabilities such as adaptive learning, predictive analytics, and uncertainty mitigation"

gemini.overclaim: for food firms, marketing capabilities, customer co-creation, market orientation, an AI marketing strategy, and in retail
gemini.note: The passage supports the general principle that AI payoff arises from combinations rather than isolated uses, but does not mention food firms, retail contexts, or the specific marketing variables claimed.
